headline: BTC jumped 7% the day Trump pushed the crypto Clarity Act
what_happened: At a White House event with crypto CEOs, Trump told Congress to pass "a fair version of the Clarity Act". Bitcoin rose 7.1% that day (64,725 to 69,335). Reuters and CNBC also credit a Treasury bond-buyback move and a short squeeze, so his words were one push of several.
name: DONALD TRUMPET
quote: So, now we need Congress to take the next step by passing the CLARITY Act
sound_credit: Audio: The White House official video, 19 Aug 2026 (US government work, public domain). Parody; no endorsement.

headline: BTC fell 4.1% the day about $6.3B was hacked out of Binance
what_happened: Late on 29 Oct (UTC) Binance reported a security breach; about 6.3 billion USD moved out in about 20 minutes (TRM Labs). Binance said user funds are safe and it would cover all losses. A hawkish Fed and a Nasdaq selloff also weighed that day.
name: 0xHACKERMAN
sound_credit: Sound: an alarm made in code. 0xHACKERMAN is a made-up character, not a real person.
